sections.Profile:
The "Chinatown" pinball machine by D. Gottlieb & Co. was released in October 1952. It was designed by Wayne Neyens, with artwork by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1952
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
